title: Memory Leak OOM – Payment Service
description: The payment-service is crashing with OOM errors. Identify the root cause and apply the correct fix.

initial_alerts.message: payment-service: Pod restarted 4 times in last 10 minutes (OOMKilled)
api-gateway: Upstream payment-service returning 502 errors (12% error rate)

payment-service.message: TransactionCache size exceeded 2M entries – eviction policy may not be working

api-gateway.message: Upstream payment-service connection refused: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.1.45:8080
Circuit breaker OPEN for payment-service after 5 consecutive failures

diagnostic_results.heap_dump payment-service: Heap dump analysis: TransactionCache holds 2,847,293 entries. Cache was initialized with maxSize=-1 (unbounded). Oldest entries date from 72 hours ago – TTL eviction is disabled. Root cause: unbounded in-memory cache growing indefinitely.
diagnostic_results.thread_dump payment-service: 12 threads in RUNNABLE state, 4 threads blocked on TransactionCache.put(). GC overhead >90% of CPU time.
diagnostic_results.ping payment-service: Request timeout – pod is in CrashLoopBackOff

restart_service.description: Restarts the pod – clears cache temporarily but does not fix root cause
restart_service.note: Service restarted. Cache cleared. Memory usage: 12%. WARNING: Root cause (unbounded cache) not fixed – will OOM again in ~45 minutes.

patch_cache_config.description: Patches TransactionCache maxSize to 50000 and enables TTL eviction
patch_cache_config.note: Cache configuration patched: maxSize=50000, ttl=3600s. Service redeployed. Memory usage stable at 34%. Root cause resolved.

increase_memory_limit.description: Increase pod memory limit from 2Gi to 8Gi
increase_memory_limit.note: Memory limit increased. This is a workaround, not a fix – the leak continues and will exhaust new limit eventually.
